usdRate.sourceName: National Bank of the Republic of Belarus, official USD rate (API)
usdRate.note: Official rate BYN 2.9462 per US dollar on 31 October 2026; World Bank 2025 average 3.07.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: National Statistical Committee of Belarus, main socio-economic indicators January-September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: CPI September 2026 was 104.6% of September 2025 (103.6% of December 2025).

inflation_projection.sourceName: Belstat CPI 4.6% (Sep 2026); World Bank CPI 6.6% in 2025
inflation_projection.note: Inflation has recently run at about 5-7% with price controls in place and Belarus has a long record of higher inflation, so 6% is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: National Bank of the Republic of Belarus, refinancing rate (API)
policy_rate.note: Refinancing rate 9.25% since 1 June 2026 (still in force on 31 October 2026).

savings_account_rate.note: No average demand-deposit rate found; nbrb.by interest-rate statistics were unreachable.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No 3-month BYN term deposit rate found: nbrb.by interest-rate statistics were unreachable.

fdr_1y_rate.note: The only figure found (about 12% on 12-13 month BYN irrevocable deposits) came from a commercial deposit-comparison site listing individual banks' offers, which cannot be cited; nbrb.by interest-rate statistics were unreachable. The all-deposit average was 5.92% in September 2026 (IMF) and the refinancing rate 9.25%.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit scheme found; some BYN deposits accept top-ups.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: IMF International Financial Statistics (MFS_IR), Belarus deposit rate

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Ministry of Finance bonds for individuals exist, but minfin.by was unreachable and no current rate was found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No 91-day government bill yield found; minfin.by and nbrb.by refused connections.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year government bond yield found; minfin.by and nbrb.by refused connections.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year government bond yield found; Belarus issues few long BYN bonds.

tax_bank_interest.note: Tax on deposit interest depends on term and currency under the Tax Code; nalog.gov.by and pravo.by were unreachable and PwC has no Belarus summary, so the rate could not be confirmed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Tax treatment of Ministry of Finance bonds for individuals could not be confirmed (nalog.gov.by and pravo.by unreachable).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: A general encyclopedia states that the Agency for Deposit Compensation guarantees individuals' deposits in full with no fixed cap, but adc.by and nbrb.by were unreachable to confirm the current rules, so no figure is given.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate found; the average lending rate was 9.98% in September 2026 (IMF IFS).

equity_return_low.sourceName: Global equity index in US dollar terms; BYN 2.95 per USD (NBRB)
equity_return_low.note: Belarus has no liquid local stock market, so equity is a global index in rubles; low case is a weak decade for world shares with mild ruble depreciation.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity long-run return in USD plus about 3% a year expected ruble depreciation; refinancing rate 9.25% (NBRB)
equity_return_base.note: Belarus has no liquid local stock market, so the base is a global index in Belarusian ruble terms (about 7% in dollars plus about 3% depreciation), within 4 points of the after-tax safe rate of about 7.5-8%.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run return in USD plus faster ruble depreciation; BYN 2.95 per USD (NBRB)
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong world shares plus faster ruble depreciation, as in 2020-2024.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, 31% below the January 2026 high
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold flat in dollars after its spike with a stable ruble.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); BYN 2.95 per USD
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises about 4% a year plus about 3% expected ruble depreciation.

gold_return_high.note: High case: gold's 2005-2025 trend continues and the ruble weakens faster.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: the average across all deposits, including low-paying ones.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: NBRB refinancing rate 9.25% (since 1 Jun 2026); IMF average deposit rate 5.92% (Sep 2026)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: BYN term deposits pay above the all-deposit average (which includes near-zero demand deposits) and track the refinancing rate, but rates are expected to fall and tax may apply to shorter deposits, so 8% is used.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in longer BYN term deposits at or slightly above the refinancing rate.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Ministry of Finance (insurance supervisor) site was unreachable; no industry claim settlement ratio found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term-life premium quotes were found for Belarus.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Public hospital care is free in state facilities; no typical out-of-pocket cost of a private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published voluntary health insurance premium table found.

oop_health_share.note: 2023 is the latest year in the World Bank series (older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: CPI 4.6% (Sep 2026) and 6.6% (2025); no published medical CPI read
goal_inflation_health.note: Medical goods and paid services usually rise faster than headline prices held down by price controls, so 7% is used.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: CPI 4.6% (Sep 2026) and 6.6% (2025); no published education CPI read
goal_inflation_education.note: Paid tuition fees tend to rise faster than headline CPI, so 7% is used.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 70.1, women 79.5 (UN WPP estimate for 2026, mid-year date used); World Bank 2024 figure 74.4.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate, mid-year date used).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 27.8 (2025, World Bank), 36.4 (2040) and 55.2 (2065, populationpyramid.net/belarus/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: Men 63, women 58 (applies to people born after 1975 under current law); secondary source because the Ministry of Labour and Social Protection Fund sites were unreachable.

retirement_age_government.note: No source read states a separate retirement age for civil servants; official legal sites were unreachable.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: NBRB refinancing rate 9.25%; IMF average deposit rate 5.92% (Sep 2026)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the fixed-income base because a retiree holds mostly shorter, more liquid deposits.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: longer BYN term deposits near the refinancing rate.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Average deposit 5.9%; global equity low case 6%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of BYN deposits and global shares.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Fixed income base 8%; global equity base 10% in BYN terms
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half BYN deposits and half global shares in ruble terms.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Fixed income high 10%; global equity high 13%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: A social pension exists for people without a labour pension, but mintrud.gov.by and ssf.gov.by were unreachable and no current amount was found.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Eligibility ages for the social pension could not be confirmed; official sites were unreachable.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity or end-of-service benefit on retirement was found in sources read.

public_pension_scheme.note: The labour pension (Social Protection Fund) pays from 63 for men and 58 for women, but indexation and tax rules could not be confirmed because ssf.gov.by and mintrud.gov.by were unreachable.

savings_account.note: Pays close to zero; most saving is done in term deposits.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit scheme; some term deposits accept top-ups.

sanchayapatra_5y.localNameEn: Ministry of Finance bonds for individuals
sanchayapatra_5y.note: Rates and tax treatment could not be confirmed.

tbill_91d.note: No regular 91-day bill market for individuals was found.

tbond_5y.note: Traded on the Belarusian Currency and Stock Exchange, mostly by banks.

tbond_10y.note: No regular 10-year BYN government bond found.

equity_fund.note: The local stock market is very small and no widely available diversified retail fund was found.

gold.note: Banks sell investment gold bars and coins.

centralBank.name: National Bank of the Republic of Belarus

insuranceRegulator.name: Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Belarus (insurance supervision)

insuranceComplaints.name: Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Belarus (insurance supervision)

oldAgeAllowance.name: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection (social pension)

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (free care in state facilities)

statistics.name: National Statistical Committee of the Republic of Belarus
